name: SkyCofl - Hypixel Skyblock AH&bazaar
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Ekwav
description:
Adds bazaar and auction house to item descriptions in hypixel skyblock based on sky.coflnet.com data. This includes global price paid, lbin, last sell, sells per day and median prices.  Enables trade and kuudra tracking. 
Ideal for lowballing and flipping
needs: Mixin: 2 points inside the game's methods
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3), Mixin (0.5)
evidence: Not run: Java did not start.
